params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS MatchedStatVars, COALESCE(SUM(NumObservations), 0) AS TotalObs, MIN(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) AS MinLatestDate FROM stats WHERE NumPlaces >= 35 AND StatVar IN ('Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Smoking_AsFractionOf_Count_Person_15OrMoreYears', 'Count_HealthEstablishment_WithUnmetNeed', 'Count_Person_Male_ConditionDiseasedPerson_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person', 'Count_Person_Female_ConditionDiseasedPerson_AsAFractionOf_Count_Person')
params.condition: MatchedStatVars = 4 AND TotalObs >= 1500 AND MinLatestDate >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
params.failure_message: 2025-cohort Health StatVar observation count or freshness validation failed.
